detail.longDescription: I’ve submitted a talk for the FOSDEM social web devroom! 🤞️ https:// pretalx.fosdem.org/fosdem-2027 /talk/review/8FQ8NTBPWJL3V33LKS7XWXHZWEFAFAGK I’m hoping to give an overview of T&S that covers the types of harms, tools, and status quo of the industry, plus what specifically is happening in the fediverse space. I’ll be chatting with a lot of the folks more involved specifically on the fediverse side than I am to prep! 😅️ # TrustAndSafety # FOSDEM # OpenSource # ROOST
